name: ScrambledText-TS-TW
title: Scrambled Text
blurb: Text scrambles with random characters as the cursor approaches, unscrambling…
description: Uses GSAP with SplitText and ScrambleTextPlugin to split text into characters. Characters within a radius of the pointer animate to scrambled state, then back to normal as the pointer moves away.
use_when: An interactive text element needs to respond dynamically to cursor proximity with a glitch-like effect.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or when rapid pointer tracking isn't supported; uses pointermove events.
a11y: Text is split into character spans and animated; meaning is preserved in data attributes. Not directly accessible during animation.
